verdict.rationale: Docs clearly cover per-domain auto-renew toggle and manual renewal via API (godaddy-docs-5/20) and there's a notification API for lifecycle events/opt-in preferences (godaddy-docs-38) that could serve as expiry notices, but no documentation of grace or redemption windows if a domain lapses. missing for 10: explicit grace/redemption period policy documentation, admin-facing expiry notice configuration details, and any confirmation that renewal reminders are sent automatically.
